statuses.automated: The job is defined on main, so it runs for pull requests. The entry names the job and links a CI result.
statuses.pending: Required, but its job is not on main yet. Has an owner or issue.
statuses.not_applicable: The combination is unsupported or does not exist. Has a reason.
statuses.skipped: Supported, intentionally not run per PR. Has a reason.

placeholders.any: The row's statement holds for every value of this field. Allowed only on not_applicable and skipped rows, which never run.
placeholders.none: This field does not apply to the row. Used for the CPU checks, which have no model, mode or topology.

job_sources.main: The job is defined on main, so it runs for pull requests.
job_sources.candidate: The job exists only on an unmerged pull request, named in `ref`.

evidence_kinds.ci: A run started automatically by GitHub Actions. The url links the run.
evidence_kinds.manual: A run someone did by hand. The url links where its result is recorded.

modes.guard: KVCR service (Guard) owns the cache memory; harness `--mode guard`. Needs host kernel >= 6.5.
modes.native: In-process KVCR, no Guard; harness `--mode nonguard`.

topologies.agg: One host, two GPUs, two aggregated workers.
topologies.disagg: One host, two GPUs, two prefill workers sharing GPU 0 and one decode worker on GPU 1 (2P+1D).
topologies.cross-node: Workers on two hosts. Not run per PR.
